messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a keystore/KMS rehearsal to emulate pen-test retest. Target: Wed 09:30 PT next week. Need ops bridge, RBAC snapshot, audit-log replay, and ephemeral key rotation test. Can someone own the keystore role sim?

katie: I can take the keystore proxy run. We should restrict to ephemeral creds + read-only audit export. :thumbsup:

pranav: +1. Also want to validate CloudKMS RPC whitelisting and ensure KMS proxy logs are shipped to the SIEM within 2m.

olivia: tagging infra: @samir — can you stand up the proxy and a temp IAM role? We'll need a presigned key export for evidence packaging.

samir: I can. Plan: create temp role `pt-keystore-sim` with MFA bypass disabled, session TTL=1h. I'll post infra commands in the runbook.

alex: perfect. Also need an RBAC snapshot (users/groups/policies) and a changelog audit. We should freeze policy changes 1h before the window.

katie: noted. Freeze window = 08:30 PT. Can we add an automated check to block any role edits during freeze?

pranav: we have a gating lambda we can enable — I'll add it to the rehearsal playbook.

olivia: can someone fetch a 24h audit extract for KMS activity and key usage? Want to replay in a staging SIEM index.

samir: running export now. command:
```
aws logs start-export --log-group-name /aws/kms --from 1765350000000 --to 1765439999000 --destination arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:destination
```
I'll upload to the evidence bucket with restricted ACL.

oncall-bot: war-room created: #ops-bridge-1765439999 at 09:30 PT. Reminder set.

katie: runbook excerpt:
```
1) Create role pt-keystore-sim
2) Attach policy: kms:Decrypt, kms:ListKeys (on test keys only)
3) Enable session TTL 1h
4) Start proxy on staging node `keystore-proxy-2`
5) Kick off audit export and SIEM ingest
```

pranav: one more ask — during the rehearsal, we should perform a mock vuln triage: inject a bogus "unauthorized-access" finding and validate alerting and ticket flow to JIRA.

alex: agreed. We'll simulate a high-priority finding at 09:45 and walk through containment and remediation steps.

olivia: who will own evidence signing and the final artifacts package for the pen testers?

samir: I'll assemble artifacts and create a signed manifest. Will add hashes + KMS-wrapped symmetric key for the package.

katie: FYI, retention/PII question: ensure exported logs are scrubbed for any PII before we hand to external assessors.

alex: Correct. Use the scrubber script from the playbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/pen-test-rehearsal

pranav: I'll create a short checklist ticket and assign owners for each step. Ticket: RWD-PT-REHEARSAL-42

alex: awesome. Final checklist before we close:
- Freeze RBAC edits 1h prior
- Proxy + role stood up
- Audit export uploaded
- SIEM ingest verified
- Mock finding injected at 09:45
- Evidence package signed and scrubbed

katie: all set from devex side. I'll post a brief postmortem template after the run.

olivia: thanks team. If anything slips, ping me and I'll escalate.

samir: will post status updates in thread during the run.

alex: thanks — closing the loop. See you all Wed.
